answers.answer_text: For wide toe box running shoes in the United States, my top pick is the Altra Torin 7, which offers a roomy wide toe box and 2E/4E widths. Another good option is the New Balance Fresh Foam X 880v14 Wide. Topo Athletic is also popular with local runners. I would avoid the Nike Vaporfly 3 because it runs narrow in the forefoot.
